title: NEW ECONOMIES (38K subscribers) — Eric on the advice founders are handed: 'They are designed to make you lose control of your company by force or by corruption'
summary: An hour-long interview built around financial gravity and the standard playbook founders are given at the earliest stage. Eric's argument is that the best practices are not neutral defaults — they are designed to transfer control, and he asks leaders to look past the surface characteristics of organizations to the forces actually shaping them.
blockquote: They are designed to make you lose control of your company by force or by corruption. Either way, it's the same to you. This company will betray you eventually. We spend so much energy as leaders focused on the surface characteristics of organizations, but also worthy of our attention are the underlying forces that shape organizations.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on NEW ECONOMIES, 'The Simple Blueprint to Never Lose Control of Your Company'
